Name: Slipstream
Components: V, S, M (a length of silk)
Description:
A 10-foot-tall, 15-foot-wide, 60-foot-long corridor of flowing space-time unfurls in a straight line in front of you, aiding or hindering travel along its length. You can choose whether the line flows towards or away from you. Creatures moving with the flow can move 2 feet for every one foot of spent movement, and those moving against it treat the area as difficult terrain.

For the duration, you can use a bonus action to reverse the direction of the flow.
